name: Standing Soleus And Achilles Stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-distance apart, one foot slightly in front of the other.
Bend both knees, keeping your back heel on the floor. Switch sides.
prompt: This is a Standing Soleus And Achilles Stretch for stretching that uses static force to primarily train the calves. These are the instructions that a person would receive: "Stand with your feet hip-distance apart, one foot slightly in front of the other. Bend both knees, keeping your back heel on the floor. Switch sides."
